title: Reset ALSA state to defaults
summary: Delete the saved ALSA state file to reset mixer settings to factory defaults. This prevents the system from restoring broken settings on boot.

steps.explain: Prevent alsa-store.service from saving the current state on shutdown by creating the directory and empty configuration file.
Create the empty configuration file that disables state saving.
Remove the current ALSA state file.
Reboot the system to load default ALSA settings.
After reboot, re-enable state saving by deleting the configuration file created in step 2.

rollback.explain: If you want to keep the old state, you cannot easily restore it after deletion. You must manually reconfigure your mixer settings using alsamixer.

warnings: This will reset all volume and mute settings to defaults.
Ensure you have a way to adjust volume (like alsamixer) after rebooting.
